column1: # SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. NOT GeoNames, and not any real place.
# Committed so `pnpm geo:audit` runs on a fresh checkout with no download and no network.
# Two reasons it is invented rather than a real slice of cities15000:
#   1. Real rows are CC BY 4.0. Vendoring them would put an attribution obligation on a test
#      fixture, which is a silly place for one.
#   2. A fixture that looks like real data invites someone to read a finding off it. Every
#      place name here is invented and every country code is in the ISO user-assigned range
#      (XE, XS, XF, XN, XU, XO), so there is nothing to mistake for a fact about the world.
# Coordinates ARE inside real continental bounding boxes, because continent and grid
# assignment are what is under test. 66 scattered rows, 11 per landmass, PLUS a deliberate
# 16-row cluster inside ~200 km so the junction score has something to measure — the first
# --stage=audit run scored junction at zero for every candidate and that is why it is here.
# Columns are the published GeoNames geoname-table order; see read-geonames.ts.
